English wire and aggregator sources (Investing.com) carried only a 16 Nov date that no issuer document supports.
Spanish press (Forbes.es, Bolsamania) supplied the ~16% reaction on the 2025 CMD day and the fact that 9M 2025 came out with that CMD. Both are context for outside_window only.
